entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Please be aware that this call may be recorded for quality assurance. Your estimated wait time is less than one minute.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi Isaac. I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Pulse monitor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the order number to pull up your account?
The name is Marcus Thorne. The order number is... VF77-01-B4. And you should know, I'm a VIP member.

Thank you, Mr. Thorne. I see your VIP account right here. I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. To best help you, could you tell me a bit more? What specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?
What does it matter? It doesn't work for me. It's uncomfortable and I don't like the app. I want my money back.
I understand. I'm just trying to diagnose the situation correctly. So, it's not defective, you just find you don't care for the product. Is that right?
Yes, that's right. Now process the return.
Okay. Thank you for clarifying, Mr. Thorne. Looking at the delivery date, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you on December 15th, which was 34 days ago.
And? Your policy is 10 days. I checked before I even bought it. Let's get this done.

I understand the confusion, but I'm afraid it's too late to return this specific item. The 10-day return policy applies to our apparel and shoes. For wearable electronics like the VeloBand Pulse, our policy is a strict 10-day return window. We are well past that period.
WHAT?! Are you kidding me? Ten days? That's insane! That's a scam! I'm a VIP member! I spend thousands of dollars with VeloFit every year! This is how you treat me?

Sir, I understand your frustration, but this specific policy is in place for critical reasons. Because the device is worn directly on the skin and tracks biometric data, for hygiene and sanitation reasons, we cannot accept it back after such an extended period.
I don't give a damn about your hygiene policy! I want to speak to a manager. Now! You're not denying my return.

I am the highest point of contact for this type of request, Mr. Thorne. A manager would have to refer to the exact same health and safety policy. After 20 days, it becomes a bio-contaminant risk, and we absolutely cannot make an exception. The system physically prevents me from generating a return label.

This is unbelievable. I'm going to light you up on social media. I'll write reviews on every single website. People are going to know that VeloFit scams its 'VIP' customers. You just lost a customer for life!

I truly am sorry, and the last thing we want is to lose a valued member like you. While a return for a refund is not possible due to the time that has passed, I can suggest our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. Customers often resell lightly used gear there. Also, because you are a VIP member and we sincerely value your business, I can offer a complimentary 12-month extension to your VIP status and ensure you get first-access codes to our next three product launches. I know it's not what you called for, but I want to do what I can.
Fine. Whatever. This whole experience has been a joke. The policy is ridiculous and so is your offer. I'll think about it. Just... ugh. Goodbye.
I understand. Thank you for your time today, Mr. Thorne. Please have a good rest of your day.
